description: Implement the backend Report Generator: database models, migration, report planner, writer, renderer, templates, schemas, and API endpoints with SSE progress streaming. This is the core Phase 4 backend.
steps: Step 1 - Database Models: Create apps/api/app/model/report.py with two models: (a) Report (id UUID PK, user_id FK users.id, conversation_id FK conversations.id nullable, title String, subtitle String nullable, author String nullable, template_id String default 'business_report_v1', outline_json JSONB nullable, status String default 'created' -- values: created/planning/writing/rendering/done/failed, progress_pct Integer default 0, error_message Text nullable, pdf_path Text nullable, created_at DateTime server_default now, updated_at DateTime server_default now onupdate now). (b) ReportSection (id UUID PK, report_id FK reports.id, chapter_number String e.g. 'BAB I', chapter_title String, section_order Integer, section_title String, content_markdown Text nullable, status String default 'pending' -- values: pending/writing/done/failed, word_count Integer default 0, created_at DateTime server_default now, updated_at DateTime server_default now onupdate now). Register both in apps/api/app/model/__init__.py.

Step 2 - Alembic Migration: Create apps/api/alembic/versions/004_add_reports_tables.py following the pattern of 003_add_knowledge_tables.py. revision='004', down_revision='003'. Create 'reports' table and 'report_sections' table with all columns, indexes on user_id and report_id.

Step 3 - Pydantic Schemas: Create apps/api/app/schema/report.py with: ReportCreate (title, template_id='business_report_v1', file_ids list[str] optional, kb_document_ids list[str] optional, custom_instructions str optional, conversation_id str optional), ReportResponse (all fields from model, from_attributes=True), ReportListResponse (id, title, status, progress_pct, template_id, created_at, updated_at), OutlineUpdate (outline_json dict), SectionResponse (all fields from ReportSection, from_attributes=True), ReportStartResponse (report_id str, pdf_path str optional).

Step 4 - Report Template: Create apps/api/app/report/ directory with __init__.py. Create apps/api/app/report/templates/business_report_v1/ directory with: (a) meta.yaml - id, name 'Laporan Bisnis', description, default_chapters list ['Pendahuluan','Tinjauan Pustaka','Metodologi','Pembahasan','Kesimpulan & Saran'], fonts ['Inter','Source Serif Pro'], page_size A4, margins {top:25mm, bottom:25mm, left:30mm, right:25mm}. (b) layout.html.j2 - full Jinja2 template with CSS Paged Media: cover page (title, subtitle, author, date), auto TOC, chapters rendered from sections list, page numbers, running headers, reference section. (c) styles.css - @page rules for A4, margins, page break, running headers/footers with counter(page), chapter headings with break-before:page, table styling, .toc styling.

Step 5 - Report Planner: Create apps/api/app/report/planner.py with async function plan_report_outline(user_request: str, file_profiles: list[dict] | None, kb_doc_summaries: list[dict] | None, template_id: str = 'business_report_v1') -> dict. It should: load template meta.yaml to get default_chapters, build a prompt instructing LLM to create outline JSON (chapters with sections, each having id, title, instruction, use_rag bool, use_data bool, target_words int), call litellm.acompletion with model='gemini/gemini-2.0-flash' (non-streaming), parse and validate JSON response, return structured outline dict. Include a PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT constant and validation logic.

Step 6 - Report Writer: Create apps/api/app/report/writer.py with: (a) async function write_section(section: dict, report_context: dict) -> str that optionally retrieves RAG chunks if use_rag=True, builds a WRITER_PROMPT with section title/instruction/materials/target_words, calls litellm.acompletion with model='cerebras/llama-3.3-70b' (non-streaming), returns markdown text. (b) async function write_full_report(report_id: str, outline: dict, db: AsyncSession, user_id: str) -> None that iterates all chapters/sections, calls write_section for each, updates ReportSection records in DB with content_markdown and status='done', updates Report.progress_pct incrementally.

Step 7 - Report Renderer: Create apps/api/app/report/renderer.py with async function render_pdf(report_id: str, db: AsyncSession) -> str. It should: query all ReportSection for the report ordered by section_order, convert each section's content_markdown to HTML using the markdown library (with tables and fenced_code extensions), load layout.html.j2 and styles.css from template directory, render full HTML with Jinja2 (passing title, subtitle, author, date, chapters data, sections HTML), try to import weasyprint - if available, convert HTML to PDF and save to storage/reports/{report_id}.pdf; if WeasyPrint not available, save as .html instead. Return the output path. Create storage/reports/ directory if needed.

Step 8 - Report Router: Create apps/api/app/router/reports.py with APIRouter prefix='/reports' tags=['reports']. Endpoints: (a) POST / - create report, run planner, save outline to report record, return ReportResponse. (b) GET / - list user's reports ordered by created_at desc. (c) GET /{report_id} - get report detail with outline. (d) PUT /{report_id}/outline - update outline_json. (e) POST /{report_id}/start - SSE streaming endpoint: set status='writing', iterate sections calling writer, then call renderer, stream progress events (event:progress with section/completed/total/pct, event:render, event:done with pdf_path). (f) GET /{report_id}/sections - list all sections for a report. (g) POST /{report_id}/sections/{section_id}/regenerate - regenerate single section. (h) GET /{report_id}/pdf - serve PDF file (FileResponse). (i) DELETE /{report_id} - delete report + sections + PDF file.
Step 9 - Register Router: Add 'from app.router import reports' in apps/api/app/router/__init__.py and add app.include_router(reports.router, prefix='/api/v1') in apps/api/app/main.py.
acceptance_criteria: apps/api/app/model/report.py exists with Report and ReportSection models properly defined
apps/api/app/schema/report.py exists with all request/response schemas
apps/api/app/report/ directory exists with planner.py, writer.py, renderer.py, __init__.py, and templates/business_report_v1/ (meta.yaml, layout.html.j2, styles.css)
Router is registered in main.py - app includes reports router
